passes.purpose: Capture the idea immediately without losing its voice or details.
Structure names, numbers, requirements, relationships, and missing fields.
Add primary evidence, counterevidence, tests, uncertainty, and citations.
Connect the work to Infinity projects, policy, provenance, ledger, and production.
Create code tasks, engineering specifications, BOMs, RFQs, tests, and release criteria.
Catch drift, unsupported claims, unsafe actions, and missing authorization.

rule: Every pass preserves the original input and emits a change record. No pass may erase an unresolved disagreement.
